BE가 묶음 생성 시 이 파일을 그대로 rules에 싣는다.

영수증 캡처 예시 및 이벤트 폼 제출을 위한 카카오 채널 메뉴 안내일 뿐 문의처를 안내하는 섹션이 아니다.
구매 조건에 딸린 사은품이나 증정품 안내가 아니라 이벤트 응모에 따른 경품 및 기프트카드 발송 안내이다.
영수증 캡처 예시 이미지에 포함된 교환·환불 문구일 뿐, 판매 제품의 소비자분쟁해결기준이나 교환·반품 규정을 안내하는 섹션이 아니다.
올영세일 구매 인증 이벤트 참여 방법과 네이버 폼 제출 기한 및 행사 기간이 상세히 안내되어 있다.
구매내역 및 영수증 인증 예시 화면에 표기된 금액일 뿐 제품 판매가나 할인가, 가격 조건을 안내하는 내용이 아니다.
공식 판매처 안내나 정품 인증 관련 내용이 포함되어 있지 않다.
네이버 폼 이벤트 응모 목적의 언급으로 판매처 안내가 아니므로 유지 기준에 해당한다.

Experience the Powerful

#Wrinkle & Pore Improvement #Real Customer Reviews

Deeply etched neck wrinkles that felt impossible to fix
have visibly softened day by day.

"The fine lines seem to have almost completely disappeared... This photo is 100% unedited. I was especially stressed about my neck wrinkles more than my face. Honestly, I never imagined or expected such astonishing results. As someone who has used Retinol products for a long time, the quality of celimax's retinal product at this price point is honestly unreal. I can confidently recommend it to anyone. I don't think I'll have to worry about wrinkles and pores anymore!"
Han Gi* - Used for 20 days / Extremely dry skin

Even if wrinkles haven't vanished completely,
they're much less noticeable than before, and I'm very satisfied.

"I never paid attention to under-eye wrinkles when I was younger, but as I got older, the fine lines under my eyes suddenly became so obvious and stressful. I tried focusing on moisturizing, but it didn't really help, leaving me frustrated. Deciding to give it a shot, I used the Retinol Shot and Retinal Shot alternately and consistently for 7 days! Even if the wrinkles haven't vanished completely, they are definitely much less noticeable, and I'm really satisfied."
Jeong Su* - Used for 1 week / Dry skin

The mild tingling sensation feels just like an esthetic clinic treatment.
Even after a single use, my pores and wrinkles look improved.

"Entering my mid-30s, I could feel my pores sagging day by day despite having dry skin... and fine wrinkles started appearing on my forehead too. Right upon application, it gave a gentle micro-tingling sensation like tiny needles, which made the experience really unique and enjoyable. It felt like being at a skincare spa haha. Even after applying it just once, my prominent pores and wrinkles visibly smoothed out, even if temporarily~~"
Jeong Ji* - Used for 1 week / First purchase / Dry skin

items.text: Retinol Shot Tightening Serum
Troubled Pores*, Wrinkles

celimax Retinal Shot
Tightening Booster Q&A
Q) Can I use it both morning and night?
A) Retinal is sensitive to light and heat, so we recommend using it in the evening. However, if you choose to use it in the morning, make sure to apply sunscreen.

Q) If there is no irritation upon first use,
can I apply more?

A) Even if you do not experience irritation upon first use, the skin's adaptation reaction to retinal can appear later. Even if no reaction occurs, please do not increase the amount or frequency of use, and we recommend following the proper usage instructions for the first 2 weeks.
Q) What are the symptoms of skin adapting to retinal?

A) If you are using retinal for the first time, your skin needs an adjustment period of up to 2 weeks.
During this adaptation period, temporary skin reactions such as redness, flaking, itching, a burning sensation, or stinging may occur.
Q) Can pregnant women use it?
A) We do not recommend use for pregnant or breastfeeding women, as hormonal changes during this time make the skin more sensitive.
Q) Are there any ingredients that shouldn't be used together?

A) Simultaneous use with products containing high concentrations of Vitamin C, physical scrubs, or exfoliating ingredients is not recommended. If using them in the same routine, we recommend adjusting your usage schedule properly (e.g., alternating days).

Thank you.
